title: Gestational Diabetes: Screening and Follow-Up Principles
subject: OBG
preview: Gestational diabetes is hyperglycemia first recognized during pregnancy and is associated with maternal and fetal complications.
quickRevision: Gestational diabetes is hyperglycemia first recognized during pregnancy and is associated with maternal and fetal complications.
Nutrition, activity, glucose monitoring and pharmacotherapy when indicated support management.
Postpartum glucose follow-up matters because later type 2 diabetes risk is increased.

sections.title: Clinical syndrome and red flags
points: Gestational diabetes is hyperglycemia first recognized during pregnancy and is associated with maternal and fetal complications.
Screening timing and diagnostic thresholds vary by accepted national or institutional criteria.

sections.title: Differentiate and manage
points: Nutrition, activity, glucose monitoring and pharmacotherapy when indicated support management.
Postpartum glucose follow-up matters because later type 2 diabetes risk is increased.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not treat a single screening strategy as universal across all countries and societies.

quiz.question: Why is postpartum follow-up important after gestational diabetes?
options: Higher future risk of type 2 diabetes
